title: Dispute Resolution for Complaints on Second-hand Smoke from Neighbours' Own Homes
what_it_is: Dispute Resolution for Complaints on Second-hand Smoke from Neighbours' Own Homes

sections.label: Repeat feedback and advisories
sections.summary: About 30% of 2025 feedback cases came from repeat providers; NEA issues advisories with agencies or Town Councils, and most cases did not recur.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: About 30% of feedback cases received in 2025 were from repeat feedback providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: When NEA receives such feedback, it works with other Government agencies or the relevant Town Council to issue advisories to surrounding residential units to encourage smokers to be considerate towards their neighbours.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA does not track whether cases are amicably resolved.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: However, most feedback cases did not recur after advisories were issued.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: If the issue remains unresolved, the relevant agency or Town Council may engage residents in person.

sections.label: Smoking prohibitions and second-hand smoke
sections.summary: With about 49,000 prohibited smoking spaces, the issue is smoke from a home pervading a neighbour's home, and work with HPB and HDB is suggested.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: That, I think, is the key issue that we are facing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I think we now have something like 49,000 spaces across the island where smoking is prohibited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And Members will be familiar with the smoking prohibitions in covered areas within the HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is precisely because we have prohibited it in so many of these areas that now, we are having to deal with the issues of what someone does in their own home when that smoke then pervades the neighbours' home.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would personally take the view that smoking is not just an undesirable behaviour at your balcony because it is going into your neighbours' home.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Certainly, we can work with the Health Promotion Board on the public health messages as well as HDB on responsible behaviours as neighbours.
